svg.title: The Pasch wall: every small Pasch-removing trade from one STS(31)
svg.desc: A ring of 316 eligible starting triples and a dot plot of all 764 reduced balanced trades of volume at most ten that remove a block of the unique Pasch in the specified root-eight Steiner triple system. Each dot is one verified final system, positioned by trade volume and final Pasch count. None reaches zero. The search is complete only for this pinned starting system and this volume bound.
